meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 收到单个文档后，Claude 会把它做成 NotebookLM 的可爱角色幻灯片 PDF，并上传生成 9:16 手机版分享链接；只做幻灯片，不做视频/播客，最终把 PDF 和链接交给用户。
howto.when: 当用户说“Wowerpoint <file>”“Make a slide deck about <file>”“Turn this report into slides”等，或要求把单个文档做成可分享幻灯片时触发。

say.note: 会生成 PDF 和 9:16 手机版分享链接。

say.text: 把 docs/市场分析.md 做成幻灯片
say.note: 会读取该文件并用可爱角色生成幻灯片。

say.text: 用可爱风格讲讲这份报告的要点
say.note: 你的这句话会直接作为生成提示。

howto.what_en: With one document as input, Claude produces a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF, uploads it for a 9:16 mobile share link, and gives the user the PDF plus the share URL. Slide decks only—no videos or podcasts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "Wowerpoint <file>", "Make a slide deck about <file>", "Turn this report into slides", or otherwise asks for a single document turned into shareable slides.

say_en.note: Produces the PDF and a mobile share link.
Reads that file and builds a kawaii deck.

say_en.text: Use kawaii characters to summarize this report
say_en.note: Your wording is used as the generation prompt.
